subject: 05_Soft_Computing

questions.question: What is the algebraic product of two grades?
questions.explanation: The algebraic product multiplies the two grades element by element.
questions.explanation_ar: الجداء الجبري يضرب الدرجتين عنصراً بعنصر.

questions.question: What does the scalar product do to a fuzzy set?
questions.question_ar: ماذا يفعل الجداء القياسي بمجموعة ضبابية؟
questions.explanation: It scales every grade by a constant alpha between zero and one.
questions.explanation_ar: يقيس كل درجة بثابت ألفا بين الصفر والواحد.

questions.question: What is the probabilistic (algebraic) sum of two grades?
options: the maximum of a and b
the minimum of a and b
a plus b minus a times b
a plus b plus a times b
options_en: the maximum of a and b
the minimum of a and b
a plus b minus a times b
a plus b plus a times b
questions.explanation: The sum is a + b - ab, so 0.5 + 0.2 - 0.10 = 0.60.

questions.question: How is the difference A minus B defined?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعرَّف الفرق A ناقص B؟
options: max of a and not b
min of a and not b
options_en: max of a and not b
min of a and not b
questions.explanation: Difference is the intersection of A with the complement of B.
questions.explanation_ar: الفرق هو تقاطع A مع متمم B، أي أدنى درجة بين A ومتمم B.

questions.question: What does the bounded sum do to two grades?
questions.explanation: It adds the grades but caps the result at one.
questions.explanation_ar: يجمع الدرجتين لكنه يقيّد الناتج عند الواحد.

questions.question: What does the bounded difference keep?
options: the lower of the two grades
min of one and a plus b
the product of the two grades
options_en: the lower of the two grades
min of one and a plus b
the product of the two grades
questions.explanation: It keeps only values where the grades sum above one.
questions.explanation_ar: يبقي فقط القيم التي يتجاوز فيها مجموع الدرجتين الواحد.

questions.question: A power with alpha above one models which hedge?
questions.question_ar: أس أكبر من واحد يمثل أي تحوير؟
questions.explanation: Alpha above one concentrates the set, modelling very.
questions.explanation_ar: ألفا أكبر من واحد تركّز المجموعة، وتعبّر عن very.

questions.question: How does the algebraic product compare with intersection?
questions.explanation: The product never exceeds the minimum, so it is a stricter AND.
questions.explanation_ar: الضرب لا يتجاوز الأدنى أبداً، فهو AND أكثر صرامة.
